name: Licensed hold-and-release / Job Reserve operating arrangement
cannot_activate_until: written regulatory confirmation that a non-redeemable, non-transferable, single-purpose grocery credit falls outside deposit-taking and payment-instrument regulation, stating what would take it back inside
grocery_rounds_position: NOT ENGAGED by Grocery Rounds under the Round credit model decided 30 Aug 2026 (25_GROCERY_ROUNDS/ROUND_CREDIT_MODEL_v1.md). A subscription buys credits that are not money, not redeemable in money and not transferable, so Dial holds an obligation to deliver groceries rather than a repayable sum. This holds only while credits settle grocery fulfilment and nothing else; a credit spendable across trades re-engages this blocker on worse facts. Boundary enforced by packages/round-credit rules RCM-001, RCM-002, RCM-015.

name: Zimbabwe fiscalisation and current tax treatment
development_mode: tax/fiscal adapter interface + versioned rules + simulator
cannot_activate_until: current VAT/IMTT/WHT rules loaded and independently checked
Zimbabwean tax counsel confirmation that a single-purpose grocery credit is taxed on issue, and what evidence of basket tax class ZIMRA expects at fiscalisation
grocery_rounds_position: Grocery Round credits are treated as a taxable supply at the point of credit issue, not a deposit (ROUND_CREDIT_MODEL_v1.md §1). This requires the basket tax class to be determinate at issue, so a Round declares its class at creation and the basket vote chooses within it — RCM-005, RCM-006, RCM-007. Tax point is not revenue recognition: consideration for an unsettled credit is a contract liability until settlement (RCM-008, RCM-010).
